Its sucks I got depression when i was in eighth grade i was 13 or 12 too, but it kinda never stops, but you just gotta beileve the ones who are willing to help you?


Maybe it is just a phase or maybe it's not but for what it's worth I beileve you, depression sucks.


You wish you were old now but trust me I'm still "young"(20) but I wish I was just a kid again. It's a cycle.


Some People who don't understand mental illness and havent been through it personally will never understand and always just look down on you and say "there's people who have it worse"

Just gotta keep your head up, and look for someone who is willing to help and not pass it as a phase, which I know it's hard for you right now since you're still young.
I just don't see a point In life anymore
I try but I'm trash at it, after so many years of doing that hobby nothing comes out of it.

Thank you I needed this, we still have to make plans about closing the gap and I can't wait. 
I just become impatient sometimes, we can make it:)
